independentReview.note: The confirmed major was that the delete step cannot isolate the tombstone write; the docs now say its fence rests on inspection, as no retained body can observe it.

retained: The first coverage-suite run failed only for netMmrByOpponent: its fixture's MMR jumps were all outliers, so the drill-down stayed empty and could not change. The fixture now seeds a paired game and in-range MMR values; the other kinds' assertions are unchanged.

The first local evidence (CHECKS-01, mutation-01 with 9 of 9 killed) bound 78d42380 before the independent review; it is superseded by CHECKS-02 and mutation-02 at f9cc5ccc, which also records the web failure names.
A key over 16 KiB is never retained (middleware/userCache.js:259-260); Node's default 16 KiB header limit keeps a URL from producing one, so no route test sends such a search.
boundaries: Stacked on unmerged DA2, C1 and F1. Exact-head CI (including web-ci's route-budget check), merge, deployment and production acceptance remain pending.
USER_CACHE_ENABLED stays off. No activation, latency, request-reduction, savings or fleet proof; G1-G3 stay unmet as ADR 0072 records.
